text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should implement high-contrast focus rings that appear immediately upon keyboard navigation. This decision enhances visibility for users relying on keyboard navigation, ensuring they can clearly see which element is focused. The trade-off here is that we may sacrifice some aesthetic design elements for the sake of accessibility, but improving usability for everyone justifies this choice.

name: Reader
text: High-contrast focus rings create a visual "siren" effect that can overwhelm users with cognitive or sensory sensitivities. A better alternative is a single-pixel, low-contrast ring that appears only after a short delay, ensuring visibility without distraction. Settle this by testing both options with users who have ADHD or autism—if the high-contrast ring causes frustration or the low-contrast ring goes unnoticed, we’ll adopt the alternative.

name: Ramp
text:
We should implement a single-pixel, low-contrast focus ring that appears after a short delay. This approach minimizes visual overwhelm for users with sensory sensitivities while still providing necessary focus indicators for keyboard navigation. The trade-off is that some users may find it less visible compared to high-contrast options, but the reduced distraction supports a broader range of user experiences and accessibility needs. Testing this solution will ensure we meet our goal of making EXCAVA usable for everyone.

name: Reader
text: Using a single-pixel, low-contrast focus ring may result in insufficient visibility for some users, especially those in bright environments or with vision impairments. A better alternative would be to implement a focus ring that balances contrast and size without being overwhelming, ensuring clarity without distraction. To settle the argument, we could conduct usability testing with a diverse group of users to gather feedback on both options and determine the most effective solution.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a **high-contrast focus indicator** with a **toggleable option** for visibility, ensuring it accommodates both keyboard navigation and sensory sensitivity; the accessibility team owns this outcome.
